entities.name: Natural History Museum Leipzig
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Natural History Museum in Leipzig is a natural history museum in the city of Leipzig, Germany, located at the northwest corner of the Inner City Ring Road in the locality Zentrum-Nordwest. The museum contains the insect collection of Alexander Julius Reichert.
